Fake news exposure: In this study, we deﬁne “fake news” as “news stories that are completely
made up.” To measure encounters with and perceptions of fake news, respondents were asked how
often they came across news stories that they thought were fake in the past 6 months and how often
they had shared a news story on social media that later they found to be fake (1 = never; 4 = often).
